regime_read: The strongest measured alignment is in semiconductors, government-linked technology, and pharma, but most signals mix fundamental activity with sentiment or affiliation rather than multiple hard-flow channels. With no scored track record yet, conviction remains modest and MRK is a WATCH because its relative strength is close to the extended threshold.
regime_read_zh: 当前最明显的多源信号集中在半导体、政府相关科技和制药领域，但多数标的仍是基本面活动与情绪或关联信号的组合，而非多个硬数据资金流渠道同时共振。由于尚无已评分战绩，整体置信度保持克制；MRK的相对强度已接近追高阈值，因此仅列为观察。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest non-extended alignment: net buying by four congressional members, strongly positive insider activity, accelerating federal grants, and a large patent cluster point in the same direction [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]. Bullish Stocktwits activity supports attention but is the least fundamental component [stocktwits_bull]; the disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation is contextual rather than causal [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU拥有最清晰且尚未过度上涨的信号组合：4名国会议员净买入、显著为正的内部人活动、联邦拨款加速以及较大的专利集群共同指向上行 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]。Stocktwits看多情绪提供关注度支持，但属于基本面最弱的一环 [stocktwits_bull]；已披露的Ro Khanna关联仅作为背景，而非因果依据 [actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: Memory-semiconductor equipment — MU grant acceleration and patent activity imply capacity and process-investment demand.
AI-server memory supply chain — stronger memory investment can benefit suppliers exposed to high-bandwidth and data-center memory.
theses.dissent: MU has underperformed SPY by 10.6 percentage points over 60 days, so the signals may reflect early positioning against continuing cyclical weakness rather than an imminent turn.

falsifier.text: Federal-grant momentum reverses and insider activity turns net negative while relative performance continues deteriorating.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: PLTR combines recent government-contract activity and acceleration with a fully bullish analyst cluster and strong retail attention [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. Disclosed links to Marjorie Taylor Greene and Cathie Wood broaden the influence graph [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood], but the Trump-linked signal is explicitly on the sell side and prevents higher conviction [trump].
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR同时具备近期政府合同及其增长、集中看多的分析师信号和较强的散户关注度 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。Marjorie Taylor Greene与Cathie Wood的已披露关联扩大了影响力网络 [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]，但特朗普关联信号明确位于卖出侧，因此无法给予更高置信度 [trump]。
second_order: Government software integrators — continued contract acceleration would support adjacent federal data-modernization vendors.
Defense AI infrastructure — PLTR contract momentum implies continued demand for secure compute, data integration, and deployment tooling.
theses.dissent: The sentiment-heavy channels may be duplicative rather than independent, while the pack's Trump-linked sell signal directly conflicts with the bullish read.

falsifier.text: Government-contract acceleration falls below its recent pace and the analyst cluster turns mixed while the Trump-linked sell signal persists.

theses.thesis: MRK shows potentially meaningful alignment between ten Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, elevated lobbying activity, and a Trump-linked buy indication [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]. However, four clinical halts create substantial internal dissent, and its 32.6-point 60-day relative gain is close enough to the extended threshold to rule out chasing.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK的10项三期临床启动、FDA适应证扩展信号、较高游说活动以及特朗普关联买入指示形成了潜在的重要共振 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]。不过，4项临床暂停构成明显的内部反证，而且其60日相对SPY上涨32.6个百分点，已足够接近过度延伸阈值，因此不宜追高。
second_order: Clinical-research services — a broad Phase 3 pipeline implies trial-management and patient-enrollment demand.
Drug-manufacturing capacity — successful late-stage programs would increase downstream production and packaging requirements.
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts may signal pipeline quality or execution problems, while much of the favorable price response may already be reflected in the recent relative gain.

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts emerge or the anticipated label expansion fails to progress.

theses.thesis: MSFT's measured demand and development ecosystem align with a large patent cluster: strong app engagement, substantial model-download activity, and GitHub momentum indicate usage across consumer and developer surfaces [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership adds strategic distribution context [actor:Sam Altman], while the Bill Ackman affiliation is qualitative and receives little weight [actor:Bill Ackman].
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的实测需求、开发者生态和大型专利集群形成共振：较强的应用参与度、可观的模型下载活动以及GitHub动量显示其在消费者与开发者两端均有使用基础 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的事实性合作提供战略分发背景 [actor:Sam Altman]，而Bill Ackman关联属于定性信息，权重较低 [actor:Bill Ackman]。
second_order: Cloud data-center infrastructure — sustained application and developer demand implies continued compute, networking, and power requirements.
Enterprise AI software — ecosystem momentum can support vendors building deployment, security, and workflow products on Microsoft platforms.
theses.dissent: The pack lacks a hard capital-flow or contract-acceleration channel, so high engagement may not translate into incremental earnings within the horizon.

falsifier.text: Developer momentum and model-download activity contract materially without corresponding improvement in app demand.

theses.thesis: QCOM's 866-patent cluster, lobbying activity, and special-situation flag create a differentiated innovation-plus-policy setup after severe relative underperformance [patent_cluster] [lobbying] [special_situation]. Tommy Tuberville's disclosed holding adds a separate political-positioning signal [actor:Tommy Tuberville], but the absence of operating-demand or contract acceleration keeps conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: QCOM的866项专利集群、游说活动和特殊情形标记，在大幅相对落后后构成差异化的“创新加政策”组合 [patent_cluster] [lobbying] [special_situation]。Tommy Tuberville已披露的持仓增加了独立的政治持仓信号 [actor:Tommy Tuberville]，但缺少经营需求或合同加速证据，因此置信度维持低位。
second_order: Edge-AI device ecosystem — QCOM patent intensity implies continued development across on-device inference and connectivity.
Wireless intellectual-property suppliers — stronger licensing or standards activity could support adjacent RF and connectivity technologies.
theses.dissent: Its 29.5-point underperformance versus SPY may reflect genuine end-market or competitive weakness that patent and lobbying signals cannot offset.

falsifier.text: Patent activity fails to translate into product or licensing momentum while relative underperformance deepens.

theses.thesis: T has only two channels, but both are relatively concrete: government-contract activity accelerated sharply and three congressional members produced net buying [gov_contract_accel] [congress_cluster]. The setup is actionable only at low conviction because there is no corroborating insider, demand, patent, or smart-money channel.
theses.thesis_zh: T虽然只有两个渠道，但两者都较为具体：政府合同活动显著加速，同时3名国会议员呈现净买入 [gov_contract_accel] [congress_cluster]。由于缺少内部人、需求、专利或聪明钱渠道的进一步佐证，该机会只能给予低置信度。
second_order: Federal telecom contractors — sustained procurement would support subcontractors involved in secure connectivity and network deployment.
Network-equipment suppliers — contract-driven buildout can pull through routing, fiber, and communications hardware demand.
theses.dissent: The unusually high acceleration may be caused by a lumpy procurement period, and congressional buying alone does not establish improving operating fundamentals.

falsifier.text: Federal contract awards normalize sharply and congressional positioning stops increasing.

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.
track_record.calibration_note_zh: 尚无判断被评分 —— 待首批核查日到期后开始累积战绩；在此之前置信保持克制。
track_record.note: Alt-data brain theses graded vs SPY. The actionable axis is calibrated by this track record; conviction defers to it.
